name: skillosophy
description: Start Codex projects with a working philosophy, relevant practical and reasoning skills, specialist role instructions, and project-local skill installation.

interface.longDescription: Before building, clarify the project goals and working approach, choose a small set of practical and reasoning skills, define specialist roles, and install selected skills into the project. Includes original workflows, philosopher lenses, and pinned upstream skill sources. Roles are instructions; installation does not launch agents or configure services.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Skillosophy before I start this project: determine its working philosophy, select useful skills and specialist roles, and install them into my project.
